name: What should I consider when planning a kitchen layout for a small space?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when planning a kitchen layout for a small space?

acceptedAnswer.text: When planning a kitchen layout for a small space, focus on efficiency and smart storage. Consider a galley or L-shaped layout to maximize counter space and workflow. Incorporate multi-functional furniture, pull-out pantry shelves, and vertical storage solutions. Light colors and reflective surfaces can make the space feel larger. Ensure appliances are appropriately sized and placed to avoid clutter and improve traffic flow within the compact area.
acceptedAnswer.description: For small kitchens, prioritize efficient layouts like galley or L-shaped, use multi-functional furniture and vertical storage, and choose light colors to enhance the sense of space.
